_about: Public-domain Thomas Kelly Cheyne (1841-1915), Oriel Professor of the Interpretation of Holy Scripture at Oxford and Old Testament critic, for the Word Hoard: his Isaiah (1870 to 1898), Micah and Hosea, two Psalms translations and commentaries, Job and Solomon, Jeremiah, The Hallowing of Criticism, the Bampton Lectures on the Psalter, Aids to the Devout Study of Criticism, Founders of Old Testament Criticism, Jewish Religious Life after the Exile, The Christian Use of the Psalms, Critica Biblica, Bible Problems, Traditions and Beliefs of Ancient Israel, The Two Religions of Israel, and his last books. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 86 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
